title: Dooku’s Escape from Geonosis
front_description: Jedi Master Yoda uses the Force to ward off Count Dooku's savage attack against Obi-Wan and Anakin. But the Count manages to escape, speeding away from Geonosis in his solar sailer. As the craft zooms away, Padmé, having recovered from her fall and about to rejoin her friends, catches sight of it and fires. But too late. Dooku escapes in his ship through the asteroid field circling Geonosis and into deep space.
back_description: Jay Shuster's concept of Count Dooku's solar sailer.
